newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Sofia to tender for consultant in telecom sale.
newsitem.headline: Sofia to tender for consultant in telecom sale.

text.p: Bulgaria's government is expected to announce on Thursday a tender for a consultant to assist in the partial sale of the state-owned Bulgarian Telecommunication Company (BTC), a deputy prime minister said on Wednesday.
The Bulgarian government has approved the sale of up to 25 percent of BTC.
"A government committee will open their offers and I hope that by the end of this month we will have an investment bank to work with," Deputy Prime Minister Doncho Konakchiev said.
He said the privatisation agency and the BTC would have separate consultants.
BTC has started the digitalisation of its antiquated national communications network as part of an programme to become a Balkan centre for servicing and for international transit traffic.
